environment.description: Lambda function deployed within VPC (subnet-0a1b2c3d, subnet-0e4f5a6b) with security group sg-0x8f3a2b1c that allows inbound only from CIDR 10.0.0.0/16. API Gateway configured as PRIVATE REST API type with resource policy restricting invoke to vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890. The VPC endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) is an interface endpoint for execute-api service with private DNS enabled, associated with the same VPC subnets. No internet gateway or NAT gateway attached to the VPC route tables for the Lambda subnets. The VPC endpoint policy document specifies Allow only for principal accounts matching the organization ID (o-abc123def4) and the specific API Gateway API ID (rest-api-id: a1b2c3d4e5). DNS resolution for the execute-api endpoint resolves only to private IPs within the VPC CIDR range.

config.vpc_endpoint_policy: Allow only o-abc123def4 and API a1b2c3d4e5
config.route_table: no igw, no nat, local routes only
config.public_route_to_api: none - no public DNS resolution possible
